verdict.rationale: Founder Law has a dedicated International Entrepreneur Parole page. It describes the up-to-30-month parole status for founders and their families, and it states the current CPI-adjusted thresholds: $264,147 from qualified U.S. investors, or $105,659 in government awards or grants. The Techstars resource library also references the pathway. Missing for 10: parole is not listed in any of the flat-fee pricing packages (so cost and offering terms are unstated), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the vendor's own pages.
